commit.message:
fix(console): delete the queue shelf's unreachable dispatch-recovery branch (TASK-33625.5)

The prompt-queue shelf carried a dispatch-recovery mode (Retry anyway /
Retry response / Unavailable). Production never entered it: presentation_for,
derive_prompt_queue_presentation's only production caller, never passed
dispatch_recovery=. Response recovery has its own #console-dispatch-recovery
card. Fed the real 'Response delivery status is unknown on the source
device.' copy, the branch pushed Discard to cell 102 on a 92-101 cell shelf.

Removed the dispatch_recovery parameter, the presentation's recovery_actions
field, the branches in sync_presentation and on_button_pressed, and the
now-unused imports. handle_primary_intent's retry_response / retry_anyway /
discard path stays: the recovery card uses it.

New test_painted_label_walk_covers_every_shelf_projection_input fails when
the projection accepts a state input, or a queue mode, that the
TASK-33625.4 painted-label walk never paints. test_queue_shelf_has_no_
dispatch_recovery_mode pins the deletion. The old shelf-recovery unit test
now pins the production dispatch_recovery_blocked state.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(lessons): a pending dispatch needs a SIGKILL of the app's own pid (TASK-33625.5)

tmux kill-server let a mid-turn Console app outlive its server by ~20 s
and finish the turn, so the relaunch showed no recovery card. A stall
after the reply streamed did the same. Record the recipe that worked:
hang before upstream, SIGKILL the pid found from the profile's
environment, and read the log's last console_send_stage phase.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(console): walk every shelf projection input and a full queue (TASK-33625.5)

Review follow-ups on the painted-label walk guard:

- The completeness guard now reads every parameter of
  derive_prompt_queue_presentation after snapshot and activity, whatever
  its kind. The keyword-only filter let a new input added before the `*`
  pass unwalked; a mutation adding one turns the widened guard red and
  left the old one green.
- The walk paints the failed-turn row behind a full queue, so the widest
  count ('Queue 10/10', one cell wider than 'Queue 1/10') is exercised on
  the shelf's longest summary at every width.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

docs(user-guide): pending-response recovery actions live on the card (TASK-33625.5)

The queue-shelf paragraph listed Retry response / Retry anyway / Discard
among the shelf's states. They sit on the recovery card above the
composer; the shelf never offers them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

test(console): give the shelf-recovery test docstrings a summary line (TASK-33625.5)

Both docstrings ran their summary into the description; split each into
a one-line summary, a blank line, and the explanation. Wording unchanged
apart from the summary and an unbroken #console-dispatch-recovery id.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

+def test_painted_label_walk_covers_every_shelf_projection_input() -> None:
+    """TASK-33625.5: the painted-label walk reaches every state the shelf can.
+
+    The walk above is the proof that no shelf state pushes a button off the
+    row, so it only holds if the walk reaches every state. The shelf once had
+    a dispatch-recovery mode, entered only through the projection's
+    ``dispatch_recovery=`` argument. Production never passed that argument
+    and the walk never exercised it. Fed the real 'Response delivery status is
+    unknown on the source device.' copy, it pushed Discard to cell 102 on a
+    92-101 cell shelf. So every queue mode, and every projection argument
+    given a non-default value, must appear in the walk. Every parameter after
+    the snapshot and the activity counts, whatever its kind: a new input
+    added before the ``*`` must be walked too.
+    """
+
+    parameters = list(
+        inspect.signature(derive_prompt_queue_presentation).parameters.values()
+    )
+    assert [parameter.name for parameter in parameters[:2]] == [
+        "snapshot",
+        "activity",
+    ]
+    defaults = {parameter.name: parameter.default for parameter in parameters[2:]}
+    walked_inputs: set[str] = set()
+    walked_modes: set[PromptQueueMode] = set()
+
+    def recording_derive(snapshot, activity, **kwargs):
+        walked_modes.add(snapshot.mode)
+        walked_inputs.update(
+            name for name, value in kwargs.items() if value != defaults[name]
+        )
+        return derive_prompt_queue_presentation(snapshot, activity, **kwargs)

+    assert list(_every_shelf_presentation(derive=recording_derive))
+    # composer_collapsed only hides the shelf, so it has no button to paint;
+    # test_region_is_revision_guarded_and_hides_preview_when_collapsed pins it.
+    unwalked = sorted(set(defaults) - walked_inputs - {"composer_collapsed"})
+    assert not unwalked, (
+        "the shelf projection accepts state inputs the painted-label walk "
+        f"never exercises: {unwalked}"
+    )

@@ -14,6 +14,33 @@ tldw_chatbook; print(tldw_chatbook.__file__)"` from OUTSIDE the repo. For a work
 worktree its own venv (`uv venv` + `uv pip install -e ".[dev,...]"`) so the worker imports the
 code under test; a shared venv's editable install points at whichever checkout installed it last.
 
+## `tmux kill-server` does not leave a pending dispatch; SIGKILL the app's own pid
+
+**TASK-33625.5, 2026-10-03.** To show the Console's response-recovery card
+live, a turn has to die between acceptance and the reply. Two attempts
+failed before one worked:
+- **The reply had already arrived.** With the review proxy in `stall` mode,
+  a "count to 300" reply streamed in full before the hang. The process was
+  SIGKILLed while **Stop** still showed, but after relaunch the turn came
+  back complete and no card appeared.
+- **The kill never landed.** In `slow` mode (12 s before upstream), the
+  capture with **Stop** showing was taken at 09:00:16, then
+  `tmux kill-server` ran. My `kill -9` guard silently did not fire. The
+  app's log then shows `provider_entry` at 09:00:23 and `reply end` at
+  09:00:37: the process outlived its tmux server by about 20 s and
+  finished the turn.
+- **What worked.** The pid was resolved from the profile's environment
+  (`ps eww -p <pid> | grep profiles/<name>/config.toml`) and SIGKILLed while
+  **Stop** showed. A `kill -0` loop confirmed it was gone. The log ends
+  after `durable_commit` and `reply start`, with no `provider_entry`.
+  Reopening the chat showed "Response delivery status is unknown on the
+  source device." with **Retry anyway** and **Discard**.
+
+**What to do.** Hang the request before upstream, not mid-stream. Kill the
+app by its own pid and confirm it is gone before relaunching. Then read the
+log's last `console_send_stage` phase: it says which recovery state the
+relaunch will show, before you go looking for it.
+
